route: No independent-means route found. nyidanmark.dk 'You want to apply' page loaded without its category list, so the route list is not confirmed from the source; earlier search results only showed work, study, au pair, family and EU categories. Not confirmed.
policy: Residents covered by the public system are registered and given a health insurance card ('yellow card'); consultation and hospital treatment are free. The borger.dk text says 'If you work legally in Denmark, you are covered by the Danish health insurance system', and I did not retrieve what applies to a non-working resident. Optional supplement: Sygeforsikringen 'danmark' Gruppe 2 (partial cover of GP-specialist, dental, medicine): 1,138 DKK a quarter per person. Members must be healthy and under 60 to join.
working: Public cover: no premium found, 0. Supplement (not required): 1,138 x 4 = 4,552 DKK a year each; couple 9,104 / 12 = 758.67 DKK a month. Gruppe 5 (basic dental, medicine, glasses): 435 x 4 = 1,740 a year each, couple 3,480 / 12 = 290 DKK.
